preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a space-separated sequence of integers.

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 40
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 40) representing the number of test cases.
Each of the T subsequent lines contains exactly two space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N) <= 10**4 and 1 <= int(K) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for N, K in [line.strip().split()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4) and K (1 ≤ K ≤ 10^9) are integers satisfying the constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.strip().split()) == int(N) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [line.strip().split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(g_i) <= int(K) for g_i in output_line.strip().split() for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, every g_i in the output satisfies 1 ≤ g_i ≤ K.

postconditions.expression: all(int(g_1) ^ int(g_2) ^ ... ^ int(g_N) == max_possible_xor for g_1, ..., g_N in [output_line.strip().split() for output_line in stdout.splitlines()] for max_possible_xor in [max_possible_xor_for_case(N, K)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the XOR of the output g_i values equals the maximum possible XOR achievable under the constraints.
